summary: Loop Industries filed an 8-K to report entry into a License Agreement with Ester Loop Infinite Technologies Private Limited (ELITe) and Ester Industries Ltd., effective February 4, 2026, and announced August 13, 2026. The agreement grants ELITe an exclusive, royalty-bearing license to Loop's depolymerization technology for manufacturing recycled products in India, with tiered royalties starting at first commercial sale. This is a routine operational contract, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic change is involved. What to watch: future operational milestones under the license.
